description: AWS CloudTrail log threat scan — Scans AWS CloudTrail events (events= JSON {Records:[...]}, array or JSON lines, or url= to a .json/.json.gz log file, up to 50k events) for signs of compromise: logging/GuardDuty/Config tampering, root activity, console logins without MFA and brute force, admin policy attachments, new access keys and login profiles, MFA removal, public bucket/snapshot exposure, security groups opened to 0.0.0.0/0, destructive deletes and KMS key deletion, AccessDenied probing, enumeration bursts, bulk secret reads, offensive tool user agents and RunInstances in rare regions. Returns findings, risk score, verdict and top identities/IPs/regions. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_cloudtrail_scan
